items.title: 68088_Wilbur B. Ware, Sr oral history interview

ctx.x: Well, to me, it's ideal, to get from Philly to New York. You know, this is kind of away from all that ratrace in New York and if you can gig, you can go up to New York and record, come on back home. Well, you know what's been happening now, I've been working with Clifford Jordan on and off, say, back in '76, before I really got ill. We played, Cliff and I, we worked Guadalupe, (unintelligible) club they had. No, first we went to Detroit for ten days. We had Roy Burrowes on trumpet, George (unintelligible) on…
